findings: Taxable FSIE receipts of a Hong Kong resident MNE may receive same-income credit capped by paid similar foreign tax and Hong Kong tax on that income.
CDTA tax claims and non-CDTA unilateral claims follow distinct routes. Ineligible bilateral direct tax is not automatically unilateral tax.
Dividend underlying profits tax not allowed bilaterally can qualify unilaterally when the MNE holds at least10percent equity at distribution. Never count the same underlying tax in both claims.
Exempt income receives no FSIE credit. A nonresident MNE may have an expense deduction route, which this credit component does not implement.
